overall_assessment: Rig Relay is a deeply engineered local-first coding-agent control plane with 488 schemas, 5 primary product surfaces, mature governance/evidence/coordination infrastructure, and a fixture-backed desktop frontend. The product is architecturally converging but not yet distribution-ready. The largest gap is the macOS packaging/signing/notarization pipeline — without it, there is no public v1. The second largest gap is that the fixture-backed Gridline frontend looks complete but is not connected to production backend data in the default code path. A direct public release requires: (1) production wiring of the Gridline frontend, (2) macOS app bundle packaging with codesigning and notarization, (3) removal or truthful deferral of fixture-backed surfaces, (4) resolution of the OMLX and provider-cache strategy decisions, (5) attorney review of legal documents, and (6) internal proving via a staged release-candidate program.

definitions.REQUIRED: Must be production-complete in public v1. Non-negotiable.
definitions.REQUIRED_IF_VISIBLE: Must be production-complete if this surface is visible in public v1. If not ready, must be hidden or deferred.
definitions.OPTIONAL_SUPPORTED: May ship in public v1 if ready. Not required.
definitions.HIDDEN_UNTIL_READY: Hidden from public v1 UI. May be wired internally. Emerges in a post-v1 release.
definitions.POST_V1: Explicitly deferred to post-v1. Not visible and not wired internally.
definitions.REJECTED_OR_REPLACED: The capability as described is not shipping. May be replaced by a different design.
definitions.BLOCKED_PENDING_DECISION: Cannot be classified until W0 or W1 publishes.

public_v1_disposition_rules.critical_rule: No polished-looking fake surface may ship. Every visible surface must be production-complete or visibly unavailable/deferred with a defensible product reason.
